title: Fire in glovebox at LANL plutonium facility sparks safety discussion
summary: According to a Defense Nuclear Facilities Safety Board (DNFSB) report, a fire occurred in a glovebox in the plutonium facility at Los Alamos National Laboratory on June 15. A test involving nonnuclear material was underway in the furnace inside the glovebox at the time of the incident.

title: NRC, FEMA talk emergency preparedness for Crane restart
summary: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission held its latest public meeting in central Pennsylvania on Tuesday to provide an update the progress being made to restart the Crane nuclear power plant (formerly Three Mile Island-1) as early as 2027. The meeting focused on emergency preparedness, with officials from both the NRC and the Federal Emergency Management Agency sharing how the agencies plan their on-site and off-site responses to potential emergencies.

title: Entergy New Orleans celebrates Loyola University’s energy efficiency success through Energy Smart
summary: Entergy New Orleans is committed to helping customers reduce energy costs and to investing in a more sustainable future for New Orleans. Through our Energy Smart program, we recently recognized Loyola University New Orleans for completing a series of energy efficiency improvements that reduced campus electricity consumption by approximately 22% and generated an estimated $700,000 in annual electricity cost savings.

title: Powering Possibility: Investing in the Next Generation at Trades 4 Life
summary: The recent Trades 4 Life event brought together industry professionals, educators, and community leaders with one shared goal: helping students see what’s possible for their future.

title: Coming up soon: Global 2026
summary: Global is a series of international conferences covering aspects of nuclear technology including the full nuclear fuel cycle and reactor systems. This year, Global 2026—which is sponsored by the American Nuclear Society’s Fuel Cycle & Waste Management Division—is taking place August 16–20 in Chicago, Ill.
